in_marathi.name: Sharulika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Beauty
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharulika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Goddess of Beauty, Radiance, and Grace. Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘sharu’ meaning ‘beauty’ and ‘lakshmi’ meaning ‘goddess of prosperity and fortune’.

in_bengali.name: Sharulika
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Goddess of Beauty
in_bengali.long_meaning: Sharulika একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Goddess of Beauty, Radiance, and Grace. Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘sharu’ meaning ‘beauty’ and ‘lakshmi’ meaning ‘goddess of prosperity and fortune’.
